newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish garment makers open shop in Russian enclave.
newsitem.headline: Polish garment makers open shop in Russian enclave.

text.p: Polish garment makers Wolczanka SA and Vistula SA plan in December to open a shop in Russia's neighbouring Kalinigrad enclave, Wolczanka's deputy president said on Wednesday.
"We plan to open a shop in December 1996...and probably a large wholesale shop there also," Elzbieta Grabska told Reuters.
She said the entire investment would reach 600,000 zlotys to 800,000 zlotys, with each firm providing half.
Grabska said Wolczanka plans to pursue an independent strategy until the middle of next year before mulling agreements with other firms.
